def create_patch_image(patch_type="white", corner="top_left", patch_size=4):
    """Create a 32x32 image with a patch at the specified corner"""

    # Patch position: 1 pixel in from corner

    elif corner == "top_right":
        y_start, x_start = 1, 32 - patch_size - 1
    elif corner == "bottom_left":
        y_start, x_start = 32 - patch_size - 1, 1
    elif corner == "bottom_right":

    if patch_type == "white":
        patch = torch.full((3, patch_size, patch_size), 255, dtype=torch.uint8)
    elif patch_type == "checkerboard":
        patch = torch.zeros(3, patch_size, patch_size, dtype=torch.uint8)

    img[:, y_start:y_start+patch_size, x_start:x_start+patch_size] = patch
    return img
